boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented HWS study environments, from library workstations to campus resource centers and late-open academic rooms.

cards.title: Rosensweig Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Level 1, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Set up for collaborative work in the library’s Level 1 commons, where instruction spaces can be flexibly arranged and HWS-credentialed printing is available.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Level 1 library commons for collaborative work and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies the Rosensweig Learning Commons on Level 1 and says it has flexible instruction spaces plus photocopying and printing with HWS credentials.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are maintained for the HWS community; bring current HWS identification where required.

cards.title: Barron Multimedia Lab
cards.subtitle: Off the Warren Hunting Smith Library atrium
cards.notes: Use the lab’s computers and printing for a focused work session; HWS lists this library-adjacent space as available for 24-hour study.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study lab with computer and printing access.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the Barron Multimedia Lab, located off the library atrium, provides 24-hour study with access to computers and printing.
cards.access_notes: The lab is off the library atrium; HWS states it is available for 24-hour study.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Single Carrels
cards.title: Warren Hunting Smith Library Single Carrels
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Choose an upper-floor single carrel when you want an individual workstation; HWS specifically lists carrels among the library’s study seating options.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels on the library’s upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS says the library’s upper floors offer study seating that includes single carrels.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; only beverages in closed containers and small snacks are permitted in reading rooms and stacks.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Study Tables
cards.title: Warren Hunting Smith Library Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Use an upper-floor table when your materials need more spread-out space; HWS includes tables among the library’s available seating and study options.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor library tables for work that needs surface area.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS says the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library provide seating and study options including tables.
cards.access_notes: Wireless access points and publicly accessible Ethernet jacks are available throughout the library; coverage can vary in book stacks.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Soft Seating
cards.title: Warren Hunting Smith Library Soft Seating
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Work from the library’s upper-floor soft seating when a less formal setup suits your reading or drafting; HWS lists it as a study option.
cards.short_summary: Soft seating among the library’s upper-floor study options.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS says the library’s upper floors provide seating and study options that include soft seating.
cards.access_notes: Use the library respectfully: HWS asks visitors to limit unnecessary phone use and be mindful of others’ quiet study.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Media Viewing Facilities
cards.title: Library Media Viewing Facilities
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Plan media-based coursework in the library’s upper-floor media-viewing facilities; confirm availability locally before relying on the space for a group session.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor library facilities for media-based academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library include facilities for media viewing.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; confirm current availability with library staff.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Group Study Facilities
cards.title: Library Group Study Facilities
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: Bring collaborators to the library’s upper-floor group-study facilities; check in with library staff if your work requires a particular room or setup.
cards.short_summary: Library facilities designated for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library include group-study facilities.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; confirm current availability with library staff.

cards.entity_name: Warren Hunting Smith Library Honors Study Facilities
cards.title: Library Honors Study Facilities
cards.subtitle: Upper floors, Warren Hunting Smith Library
cards.notes: For Honors-program work, ask library staff about the upper-floor study facilities HWS identifies for Honors students and their current availability.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor library study facilities for Honors students.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS states that the upper floors of Warren Hunting Smith Library include study facilities for students in the Honors program.
cards.access_notes: Library facilities are for the HWS community; ask library staff about current access to Honors study facilities.

cards.title: Blackwell Room
cards.subtitle: Demarest Hall
cards.notes: Use the Blackwell Room for an evening study session in Demarest Hall; HWS lists the room specifically as open for study until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A named Demarest Hall room with study access until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists the Blackwell Room in Demarest Hall as open for study until midnight.
cards.access_notes: HWS lists the Blackwell Room in Demarest Hall as open for study until midnight; verify exceptions or break-period changes before going.

cards.title: LGBTQ+ Resource Center
cards.subtitle: 402 Pulteney Street
cards.notes: Use the Resource Center as a study space during its open hours, and contact staff to arrange access for student-organization meetings or events.
cards.short_summary: A campus resource center available for study during open hours.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS encourages students to use the LGBTQ+ Resource Center at 402 Pulteney Street as a social or study space during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Available as a study space during open hours; student organizations can work with Resource Center staff to arrange meeting and event access.
